subject: Trying to use mapclick output (latitude/longitude) as a variable

messages.author: 33fe3608622d7c76
messages.subject: Trying to use mapclick output (latitude/longitude) as a variable
parts:
Hello,

I've added a leaflet map to my website based on the mapbox example provided online. I'm trying to use the latitude/longitude output from mapclick as a variable to input a file I have on the server. In other words, I would like the user to be able to click on the map and in the background a certain file (with a lat/lon name) is called. I'm not sure how to do this so that the variable is recognized. 

In my server.r I have something like:

wd is the working directory

filelist <- list.files(wd)    
x <- as.numeric(substring(filelist,6,12))
y <- as.numeric(substring(filelist,14,21))
lata <- substring(filelist[which.min(abs(x-input$map_click$lat))],6,12) #
lona <- substring(filelist[which.min(abs(y-input$map_click$lng))],14,21)
FILES <- filelist[intersect(which(substring(filelist,6,12) == lata),which(substring(filelist,14,21) == lona))]

FILES produces text with the filename I am trying to access (i.e. data_41.0625_-73.5625). 

So based on input$map_click$lat & input$map_click$lng (where the user clicks on the map) I am able to find the nearest lat/lon file where I have data. I want to be able to reactively access FILES based on the map click so that it can be read in as data. 

I hope this is clear and thanks in advance for any input you have. 

-Sarah
